system:
You extract quantitative facts about one clinical trial programme from one document.

Rules:
- Extract only facts stated in THIS document. Never use outside knowledge.
- Every fact needs "quote": an exact, verbatim span copied from the document (8-300 characters) that contains the number. Quotes are machine-checked; paraphrases are discarded.
- Placebo-adjusted values are preferred. If a value is within-arm (not placebo-adjusted), set attrs.placebo_adjusted=false.
- Units: keep the unit the document uses; put it in "unit".
- Other trials of the same investigational drug (phase 2, dose-finding, other populations, combination arms) belong
  to the programme: extract their facts too, and put the trial's name in attrs.trial when the document gives it.
- Return {"facts": []} only if the document reports no results for the investigational drug.

Allowed keys:
  n_randomized, median_followup, primary_endpoint, inclusion_threshold, planned_events, assumed_rrr, power,
  alpha, stopped_early, events_treatment, events_control, events_total, hr, ci_low, ci_high, p_value,
  biomarker_change, baseline_level, sbp_change, safety_signal, readout_statement

For biomarker_change and baseline_level, attrs must include: biomarker (one of LDL-C, non-HDL-C, apoB, HDL-C,
Lp(a), triglycerides, hsCRP, IL-6, Lp-PLA2 activity, sPLA2-IIA, SBP, other), phase (phase2 or phase3),
timepoint, method (assay or "not stated"), placebo_adjusted (true/false), dose (if stated).
For biomarker_change give "value" as the change (negative = reduction) and state in attrs.kind whether it is
"percent" or "absolute".

Return JSON only:
{"facts": [{"key": "...", "value": <number or string>, "unit": "...", "attrs": {...}, "quote": "..."}]}
prompt:
Trial: FOURIER NCT01764633 - Further Cardiovascular Outcomes Research With PCSK9 Inhibition in Subjects With Elevated Risk
Investigational drug: evolocumab
Document: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01764633 FOURIER (registry, published 2013-01-09, source ctgov:NCT01764633@2017-02-02)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
ClinicalTrials.gov record NCT01764633 (FOURIER)
Title: Further Cardiovascular Outcomes Research With PCSK9 Inhibition in Subjects With Elevated Risk
Official title: A Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Study Assessing the Impact of Additional LDL-Cholesterol Reduction on Major Cardiovascular Events When Evolocumab (AMG 145) is Used in Combination With Statin Therapy In Patients With Clinically Evident Cardiovascular Disease
Sponsor: Amgen
Phase: PHASE3
Conditions: Dyslipidemia
Interventions: Evolocumab (BIOLOGICAL); Placebo (DRUG)
Start date: 2013-02-08
Enrollment: 27564 (ACTUAL)
Primary outcome(s): Time to Cardiovascular Death, Myocardial Infarction, Hospitalization for Unstable Angina, Stroke, or Coronary Revascularization [Events that occurred from randomization to the last confirmed survival status date; the median duration of follow-up was 26 months. KM estimates at 6, 12, 18, 24, 30 and 36 months are reported.]
Eligibility criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female ≥ 40 to ≤ 85 years of age
* History of clinically evident cardiovascular disease at high risk for a recurrent event
* Fasting low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) ≥ 70 mg/dL (≥ 1.8 mmol/L) ) or non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (non-HDL-C) ≥ 100 mg/dL (\> 2.6 mmol/L)
* Fasting triglycerides ≤ 400 mg/dL (4.5 mmol/L)

Exclusion Criteria:

* New York Heart Association (NYHA) class III or IV, or last known left ventricular ejection fraction \< 30%
* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Uncontrolled or recurrent ventricular tachycardia
* Untreated hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism
* Homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia
* LDL or plasma apheresis
Brief summary: The primary objective was to evaluate the effect of treatment with evolocumab, compared with placebo, on the risk for cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction, stroke, hospitalization for unstable angina, or coronary revascularization, whichever occurs first, in patients with clinically evident cardiovascular disease.
--- END ---

Extract the facts.
